selected_observations.excerpt: Term: 24 months. The agreement auto-renews for successive 12-month periods unless either party gives 90 days' written notice before the then-current term ends.

selection_rationale: Rolling-term judgment depends on the stated Term language in MSA-NBA-2021.
known_missing_information: Month-to-month and successive-period language may overlap with auto_renewal; P2 did not compile contract_obligation_kind.
